description: Source code implementing management of aperiodic SRS resources in a 5G NR DU, including resource allocation, deallocation, and slot offset computation based on 3GPP TS 38.214 specifications.

classes.name: du_srs_aperiodic_res_mng
classes.description: Manages the allocation and deallocation of aperiodic SRS resources for multiple cells in a 5G NR DU.

classes.name: du_srs_aperiodic_res_mng::cell_context
classes.description: Holds per-cell configuration and helper functions for SRS resource management.

methods.name: compute_slot_offset
methods.description: Calculates the slot offset for SRS resource activation based on cell configuration and TDD/FDD mode.

methods.name: du_srs_aperiodic_res_mng::cell_context::fill_srs_res_parameters
methods.description: Fills in the SRS resource parameters based on the resource configuration and cell parameters.

methods.name: du_srs_aperiodic_res_mng::cell_context::fill_srs_res_set
methods.description: Sets up the SRS resource set with the specified resource ID and slot offset.

methods.name: du_srs_aperiodic_res_mng::alloc_resources
methods.description: Allocates SRS resources for each UE in the cell group configuration.

methods.name: du_srs_aperiodic_res_mng::dealloc_resources
methods.description: Deallocates SRS resources for each UE in the cell group configuration.

methods.name: du_srs_aperiodic_res_mng::cell_context::cell_context
methods.description: Constructor initializing cell-specific SRS configuration and resource list.
